selection.selection_scope: One fixed material window on both inputs; actual native XYZ measures its physical support
selection.selection_limit: Authored shared window selected by actual width and normal diagnostics; not automatic natural-shoulder detection
selection.reflection_scope: Canonical abs material X/Y coordinates; caller constructively reflects geometry
selection.boundary_scope: Quintic fade to zero at all four material patch boundaries; front symmetry seam remains outside the patch

folds.amplitude_scope: Pilot comparison condition, not a user design constraint
folds.normal_scope: Arc-weighted incoming native triangle normals, longitudinally pooled and PCHIP interpolated
folds.fine_detail_scope: Existing bulb is replaced in this broad patch in both CLEAR_ONLY and BROAD_ACTIVE; no new bulb evaluation
folds.topology_scope: Inherited connectivity is held only for this comparison
